universities.summary: Vels Institute of Science, Technology & Advanced Studies is a private deemed-to-be university in Chennai. universities.campusLifestyle: Pallavaram campus combines academic departments, laboratories, library facilities and student activities. Degree curricula differ across schools; engineering and postgraduate programmes include their own practical and project requirements. Confirm the teaching site on the offer, especially for medical, maritime and off-campus courses.
universities.cityProfile: The Pallavaram campus is at Velan Nagar, P.V.Vaithiyalingam Road, Chennai 600117. VISTAS also has other teaching locations; the medical college is at Manjankaranai in Tiruvallur and maritime study is associated with Thalambur. Plan accommodation and travel against the campus on your own admission offer.
universities.practicalExposure: Programme regulations set the academic curriculum, assessment and practical requirements. Postgraduate engineering includes phase-I and phase-II project work. The general MBA 2024 curriculum includes internship and a final project. Obtain the approved branch curriculum, training location, supervision and any compulsory practical charges for the exact award.
universities.hostelOverview: Separate accommodation is described for undergraduate and postgraduate men and women, and for international students. Rooms have two to four occupants, with air-conditioned options, laundry and Wi-Fi. Library access is available to residents from 8 am to 8 pm. faq.question: What is VISTAS’s official university identity?
faq.answer: Vels Institute of Science, Technology & Advanced Studies is the Chennai deemed-to-be university listed by UGC, dated 4 June 2008. Vels University is a commonly used name; VELS Group ownership alone does not establish that another college awards VISTAS degrees.

faq.question: Which teaching campus should I select?
faq.answer: The degree routes here relate to Pallavaram, Chennai. VISTAS also uses other teaching locations. Check the exact campus on the application and offer; medical, maritime and other off-campus courses need their own programme and timetable assessment.

faq.question: Are all undergraduate programmes four years?
faq.answer: The current faculty regulations distinguish a three-year bachelor route from optional four-year honours or honours-with-research study. Engineering and health awards have their own duration. Select the exact degree and exit route rather than assuming that a standard bachelor listing guarantees honours.

faq.question: What is the teaching language?
faq.answer: Undergraduate engineering regulations 2022 and postgraduate engineering regulations 2023 specify English. The published 2021 UG policy states English except named language papers. Historical 2021 regulations common to full-timePG programmes specify English with the same exception; currentMBA regulations corroborate English within management. Programme-specific language rules take precedence. Follow the language and policy year recorded for the selected award.

faq.question: When did first-year classes begin in 2026?
faq.answer: The university’s 2026–27 calendar scheduled 3 August 2026 for all first-year UG and PG programmes. That is a historical cohort date. Obtain the next application and class-start notice for a future intake; medical, maritime and off-campus schedules require separate confirmation.

faq.question: Are the published fees tuition only?
faq.answer: The current 2026–27 school tables separate tuition per semester from Other Fee per semester and show combined annual totals. Tuition comparisons here use the isolated tuition, annualised over two semesters. Other compulsory charges, hostel and food need separate budgeting.

faq.question: Can merit categories or shifts change the fee?
faq.answer: Yes. Some engineering rates depend on total qualifying marks, and some commerce or computing courses have separate shift rates. The selected rate and any structured alternatives state their exact category; a discounted band is not a universal fee.

faq.question: Do Indian fees apply to overseas applicants?
faq.answer: Foreign nationals, NRI and OCI applicants need a separate category quotation. The domestic tuition figure does not establish overseas tuition or the complete admission budget. Obtain compulsory charges, payment stages and residence costs alongside the quotation.

faq.question: Can international applicants apply?
faq.answer: VISTAS invites international and NRI UG and PG applications. International qualifications need university assessment, AIU equivalence and certified English translations where applicable. Programme-specific subject, marks, entrance and professional-regulator conditions still apply.

faq.question: Which application documents are listed for overseas students?
faq.answer: The international route lists qualifying academic certificates and transcripts, AIU equivalence, certified translations, passport personal-details page, a recent photograph and NRI-status proof where applicable. Obtain the current programme checklist for the chosen applicant category.

faq.question: What accommodation and meals are described?
faq.answer: Separate UG, PG and international-student accommodation is available, with shared rooms, air-conditioned options, laundry and Wi-Fi. Hostel dining includes vegetarian and non-vegetarian meals, Indian food and multi-cuisine catering. Room allotment, food arrangements and charges require current confirmation.

faq.question: What wellbeing support is available?
faq.answer: The Centre for Well-being offers confidential counselling, individual support and workshops. Campus medical facilities include a first-aid clinic, qualified nursing support, emergency assistance and an ambulance, with advanced-care access through the medical college hospital in Tiruvallur.

faq.question: Does institutional accreditation approve every professional course?
faq.answer: UGC designation and NAAC accreditation concern the institution. They do not by themselves establish an individual professional programme’s current approval, registration eligibility or practice rights. Check the exact award and relevant professional regulator before enrolment.

Vels Institute of Science, Technology & Advanced Studies is a private deemed-to-be university in Chennai. Its Pallavaram campus offers regular degrees across engineering,computing,sciences,commerce,management,arts and health disciplines,with separate medical and other teaching locations.

Pallavaram campus combines academic departments,laboratories,library facilities and student activities. Degree curricula differ across schools; engineering and postgraduate programmes include their own practical and project requirements. Confirm the teaching site on the offer,especially for medical,maritime and off-campus courses.

The Pallavaram campus is at Velan Nagar,P.V.Vaithiyalingam Road,Chennai600117. VISTAS also has other teaching locations; the medical college is at Manjankaranai in Tiruvallur and maritime study is associated with Thalambur. Plan accommodation and travel against the campus on your own admission offer.

Programme regulations set the academic curriculum,assessment and practical requirements. Postgraduate engineering includes phase-I and phase-II project work. The general MBA2024curriculum includes internship and a final project. Obtain the approved branch curriculum,training location,supervision and any compulsory practical charges for the exact award.

Separate accommodation is described for undergraduate and postgraduate men and women,and for international students. Rooms have two to four occupants,with air-conditioned options,laundry and Wi-Fi. Library access is available to residents from8am to8pm. Confirm the room allotment,deposit,mess and current residence rules before accepting accommodation.

Hostel dining includes vegetarian and non-vegetarian meals,Indian food and multi-cuisine catering. Confirm the current meal plan,allergy or dietary arrangements and mess charges with the residence office.

Campus health support includes a first-aid clinic,nursing support,emergency medical assistance and an ambulance. The university describes access to Vels Medical College and Hospital in Tiruvallur for advanced care. Follow residence discipline and the practical-safety instructions for your programme.

The Centre for Well-being offers confidential counselling,individual emotional support and workshops on stress and self-care.
